System design & behavioural · Debugging & quality

How do you debug a React application with high CPU utilization?

Answer

  1. Reproduce and open Chrome DevTools Performance tab — record, look for long tasks, which functions use the most scripting time (flame chart).
  2. React DevTools Profiler — find components re-rendering too often or taking long, and why.
  3. Common culprits: infinite re-render loops (effect setting state it depends on), unthrottled scroll/resize/mousemove handlers, setInterval without cleanup, huge lists without virtualization, heavy computations every render, animations via JS instead of CSS, polling too frequently, memory leaks causing GC pressure.
  4. Fix: memoize, throttle/debounce, virtualize, move heavy work to a Web Worker, use useTransition/useDeferredValue, clean up effects.
  5. Verify with the profiler again and add monitoring.
